facts.value: Worcester County, Maryland Resolution No. 26-18, concerning data centers and cable landing stations.
The executed resolution states it was passed July 21, 2026.
The resolution cites Worcester County Zoning Ordinance section 1-118(b)(6) as authority for the County Commissioners to impose moratoria by resolution.

The executed text imposes a moratorium on applications for or issuance of permits and on all related Board of Zoning Appeals proceedings, each for twelve months or until the Commissioners rescind the resolution.
The resolution defines data centers and cable landing stations; its cable-landing-station definition excludes data storage, management, processing or computation.
A separate county notice says the moratorium applies to pending and future applications and that previously submitted BZA applications were placed on hold.

The image shows signatures on the lines for President Theodore J. Elder, Vice President Madison J. Bunting Jr., and Commissioners Caryn G. Abbott, Eric J. Fiori, Joseph M. Mitrecic and Diana Purnell. Chief Administrative Officer Weston S. Young signed the attestation. Commissioner Anthony W. Bertino Jr.'s line is blank.
